conclusion: 今日主线是: AI 工作台正在从“多入口可用”进入“记忆、权限、预算和浏览器证据都要可治理”的阶段。Codex CLI 0.150.1 把 Remote compaction 的图片预算纳入上下文管理，说明长会话里的截图/图片不能再被当作免费上下文；ChatGPT Learn 的 8 月 24-28 周报把浏览器、Site tools(WebMCP)、云浏览器登录、事件触发任务、Apple Messages、Computer History 串在同一个工作面里；GitHub 和 VS Code 文档则把 Copilot/agent 的企业配置拆成 server、MDM、file 三条下发路径和权限优先级；Agents SDK 0.22.0 继续补 guardrail redaction、失败态抛错和 usage 隔离。
excerpt: 2026-08-28 的重点是把上下文载重、浏览器入口、插件/MCP 审批和企业 AI 设置沉淀成可复用治理资产。
今天的判断很明确: 代理越能跨浏览器、插件、事件和记忆工作，越要先定义 lane、权限、预算、读回和停止条件。

signals.title: Codex CLI 0.150.1 fixes Remote compaction image budgeting
signals.author: OpenAI / Codex changelog
signals.summary: Remote compaction now counts retained images toward its token budget, so screenshot-heavy Codex work needs a context payload ledger.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 建 Context Payload Budget，分别记录文本、截图、图片和文件摘录。

signals.title: Codex CLI 0.150.1 GitHub release
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The public release confirms retained-image compaction behavior and provides a version anchor for local verification.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 长任务含图片时记录 CLI 版本、compaction 行为和是否需要换车。

signals.title: Work with more websites in ChatGPT Work and Codex
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
signals.summary: Browser work now has separate local, built-in tool, and cloud sign-in lanes, each with different evidence rules.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 每个网页任务先声明 browser lane、允许动作、读回方法和停止条件。

signals.title: Site tools(WebMCP) expose website actions to agents
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
signals.summary: Site tools turn website actions into structured calls, reducing brittle button-and-pixel automation.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 为内部站点写 Agent Tool Surface Spec，再开放给代理调用。

signals.title: Cloud browser sign-in is a separate account lane
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
signals.summary: Cloud browser sign-in supports account-needed tasks, but it is not the same as using a local browser profile.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 凭证只走登录流程；不要把 cloud-browser 证据和 local-browser 证据混用。

signals.title: Scheduled tasks can respond to Gmail, Slack, and GitHub events
signals.author: OpenAI Help Center
signals.summary: Scheduled tasks are becoming shared event-driven workspace assets rather than only personal cron reminders.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 给事件任务写 Trigger Envelope: source、payload、idempotency、owner 和重复事件策略。

signals.title: Premium seats change capacity planning for ChatGPT Business and Codex
signals.author: OpenAI Help Center
signals.summary: Premium seats separate high-usage capacity from ordinary workspace access while keeping admin spend controls.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 把 seat entitlement 和 run-level spend gate 分开记录。

signals.title: Computer History turns Mac activity into opt-in memories
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
signals.summary: Mac activity can become timeline and memory context, but only under explicit user or admin control.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 建 Computer History Boundary Card，规定哪些 app/site 可入记忆、何时暂停和删除。

signals.title: Record & Replay converts stable desktop workflows into skills
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
signals.summary: Demonstrated macOS/browser workflows can become reusable skills if their inputs and stop conditions are clean.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 录制前清理敏感窗口，录后验证 skill 输入、停止条件和读回步骤。

signals.title: Plugins package skills, connectors, MCP servers, hooks, and task templates
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
signals.summary: Plugins are reusable workflow bundles across ChatGPT and Codex surfaces, not merely a single extension button.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 建 Plugin Capability Inventory，列出 skills、connectors、MCP、hooks 和写动作。

signals.title: Plugin-bundled MCP servers need explicit tool policy
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
signals.summary: Plugin-provided MCP servers still need explicit on/off and per-tool policy under the plugin configuration path.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 对每个 MCP server 记录 enabled_tools、disabled_tools、approval mode 和身份边界。

signals.title: Configuration reference exposes per-plugin MCP approval controls
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT Learn
signals.summary: The config schema gives a concrete structure for least-privilege plugin/MCP tool approvals.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 用 Plugin/MCP Approval Matrix 区分 read/search、write、send、publish 和 unknown。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot enterprise managed settings support multiple deployment paths
signals.author: GitHub Docs
signals.summary: Agent settings can be deployed through server-side, MDM, or file-based channels with different coverage and timing.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 写 Managed AI Settings Runbook，记录默认值、override、交付路径和验证步骤。

signals.title: Enterprise managed settings reference documents bypass and permission controls
signals.author: GitHub Docs
signals.summary: The reference documents bypass and permission keys and shows client support can vary by surface.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 不假设所有客户端都支持同一权限 key；维护客户端支持矩阵。

signals.title: VS Code explains AI settings precedence across MDM, server and file channels
signals.author: Visual Studio Code Docs
signals.summary: VS Code enterprise AI settings can come from multiple channels, so policy drift must be diagnosed by precedence.
signals.takeaway: 动作: AI 设置漂移时读回 MDM、server 和 file 三条路径，再指定单一 owner。

signals.title: Codex GitHub Action runs Codex in workflows with a secure proxy
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: Codex can run inside GitHub Actions with workflow permissions and proxy/API boundaries.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 把 CI Codex 当生产自动化: 固定权限、代理/API 路径、产物、复核和回滚。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 hardens guardrails, failed status handling and usage isolation
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The SDK redacts blocked tool outputs, raises terminal failed/incomplete responses, and isolates checkpoint usage.
signals.takeaway: 动作: 升级前补 redaction、terminal failure、usage checkpoint 和 nested-agent 聚合测试。

knowledge.title: Context Payload Budget
knowledge.summary: 把长会话里的文本、图片、截图、文件摘录和工具输出都当成可计量 payload，而不是只看 token 文本。
knowledge.usage: 用于 Codex Remote、Computer Use、设计走查、截图密集 debug、长会话换车和自动化记忆。

knowledge.title: Browser Lane Evidence Matrix
knowledge.summary: 把网页任务分成 local browser、built-in browser Site tools、cloud browser sign-in 和公开网页只读四类 lane，每类有不同证据和停止条件。
knowledge.usage: 用于网站测试、账号内只读查询、Work 网页任务、Codex 修 UI、插件或 WebMCP 工具调用。

knowledge.title: Plugin/MCP Approval Matrix
knowledge.summary: 对每个插件和 MCP server 记录 enabled、identity、enabled_tools、disabled_tools、default approval、per-tool approval 和写动作。
knowledge.usage: 用于 Codex CLI/desktop 插件、ChatGPT Work connectors、团队插件市场、Figma/GitHub/Gmail/Slack 等工具接入。

knowledge.title: Managed AI Settings Runbook
knowledge.summary: 把 agent/AI 客户端设置当成运维配置: server-managed、MDM-managed、file-based、客户端支持矩阵、优先级和验证步骤。
knowledge.usage: 用于 GitHub Copilot、VS Code AI、Codex CLI、企业插件、模型策略、MCP allowlist 和 bypass/auto-approve 禁用。
